items.body: The peer was sacked from his position in 2025 after his close links with Jeffrey Epstein emerged The Liberal Democrats are saying the UK needs a proper plan for immigration. This is from the party’s asylum and immigration spokesperson, Paul Kohler . Britain needs to regain control of its immigration system after the chaos of Brexit. Yet sixteen years after David Cameron’s ‘tens of thousands’ pledge, six prime ministers and ten home secretaries have overseen wild swings in immigration numbers with net migration now set to fall below zero. Britain faces serious demographic and economic challenges, and urgently needs a proper immigration plan to support our economy and public services. The fall in net migration is mainly a result of changes made by the previous Conservative government. We now need to go even further with a legally binding annual cap, set by parliament, at a far lower level. British and European people are leaving in their droves because of Labour’s high taxes whilst non-EU immigration remains far too high. British families are left to pay for it with lower wages, longer waits for a GP appointment and homes they cannot afford. Mass low-skilled immigration must end completely as it is bad for our economy and corrosive to our society. Continue reading...

items.summary: Victims’ commissioner welcomes strengthening of law in England and Wales but calls for measures to tackle convicted stalkers Ministers will create a new stalking offence so that victims will no longer have to prove fear or distress to seek protection under the law, the Home Offic
items.body: Victims’ commissioner welcomes strengthening of law in England and Wales but calls for measures to tackle convicted stalkers Ministers will create a new stalking offence so that victims will no longer have to prove fear or distress to seek protection under the law, the Home Office has announced. Under current laws, the underlying offence of harassment in England and Wales, as well as additional factors such as the victim’s alarm, must be established for it to be considered stalking. The new law, alongside other changes, will focus on the perpetrator’s behaviour instead, officials said. Continue reading...

items.body: Beaches close as Los Angeles and La Jolla see all-time high tides and big waves batter landmark pier in Pacifica Super El Niño weather brought record-breaking high tides up and down the California coast on Wednesday, sending seawater rushing into beachside communities and flooding roads and businesses. As big waves battered the coast, the tip of a landmark pier in Pacifica, south of San Francisco, was slammed into the sea, local news outlets reported . The pier, which had once housed a favorite local cafe , had previously suffered structural damage and had been closed to the public, the San Francisco Chronicle reported , and collapsed after contact with ocean swells 12 times stronger than on an average November day.
